name: Riddle Voice
text: I am always hungry, devouring the fleeting seconds. Yet time alone cannot safe me. Who am I?

name: Narrator
text: Kyra hesitates, her mind racing. After a moment of silence, a familiar voice echoes in her mind

name: Tom's Voice
text: It’s closer than you think… a thing that all fear, yet cannot escape.

name: Narrator
text: The phone emits a low, mocking chuckle.

name: Entity Voice
text: Well-thought, chosen one.. Death is your new eternal ship… and you, my dear, are here to stay ... for eternity.

name: Narrator
text: Kyra stands frozen, gripping the radio, her pulse quickening as Tom’s message fades into the static.

name: Kyra
text: Leave the ship… leave the sea… warn everybody..

name: Kyra
text: But how? The doors… the halls… the statues!...

name: Kyra
text: it’s like they’re shifting, leading me in repetitive dark circles…I cannot understand nor escape  from!...

name: Kyra
text: I must… I must be the one who decides my fate

name: Kyra
text: and I’ll be the one telling my story... no matter what the price is..

name: Narrator
text: She turns, steps toward the door, and disappears into the shadows as the whispers fade.
